title: Anytime Posterior Sampling under Nested CVaR Constraints

comparators.scope: 413 frozen explicit contracts covering the original 27 source anchors, actual source execution, main bounds, endpoint and supporting claims.

main_results.scope: Signed Bayesian performance bounds for a finite randomized Markov process with arbitrary prior, exact posterior-copy law, Borel-oracle execution and categorical concentration inputs.
On one common probability-one event, calibration counts obey all-horizon bounds and have sparse asymptotic frequency under strict feasibility.
A risk-bank bound for a fixed horizon K and confidence delta under the natural source filtration; it is not a confidence sequence.
Stage-dependent CVaR tail masses and approximate exploitation with certificates at actual calls; the approximation errors enter the performance bounds.
Exact rational planning reduction to degree-two existential-real constraints with coefficient and payload bounds; machine complexity-class transfer requires external arithmetic and decision results.
